# Diver's Gambit

> A PADI Distinctive Specialty in which buddy teams play timed chess underwater at 6-12 m / 20-40 ft. The game is a novelty wrapper around real diver training: precise buoyancy control, non-verbal communication via slate and hand signals, and air/task management under load. Certification ("Diver's Gambit Master") counts as one of five specialties toward the PADI Master Scuba Diver rating.

## Pages
- [Home](https://diversgambit.com/): Overview of the specialty and the diving skills the game trains.
- [The Course](https://diversgambit.com/course.html): Standards, prerequisites, the three open-water dives, and continuing-education pathways.
- [The Game](https://diversgambit.com/rules.html): Full rules - objective and end conditions, the 60-second move clock, scoring by material and remaining air, fouls, the hand-signal system, the slate layout, variants, and tournament format.
- [Enquire](https://diversgambit.com/contact.html): Contact form for course dates, locations, and prerequisites.

## Key facts
- Prerequisite: PADI Advanced Open Water Diver or Peak Performance Buoyancy Specialty.
- Minimum age 12. Depth 6-12 m / 20-40 ft. Three open-water dives, ~9-10 hours total.
- Play is in buddy teams over a weighted board; communication by slate and hand signals only.
- A match ends at checkmate or stalemate, or when any diver reaches a 500 PSI reserve (counts as a loss).
- Scoring when undecided: material points (P1 N/B3 R5 Q9) plus remaining air.

## Note
Scuba diving is inherently dangerous. This site is informational and educational only - it is not dive training, certification, or medical advice.
